questions.text:
Using Resources B and K (pages 4 and 10 of the resource booklet), complete the precis map below to show the following features:
- Changi Airport area
- Jurong Island area
- Thomson Nature Park area in the centre of the island
- Sentosa Island
- bridge linking Singapore to Malaysia at Johor at 033236.

Include all mapping conventions.
questions.expectedAnswer: Precis map showing Changi Airport area, Jurong Island area, Thomson Nature Park in centre,...
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Completes precis map using skills and conventions to show features of Singapore, although with only some accuracy. Merit: Completes precis map using skills and conventions to show most of the main features of Singapore to a high level of accuracy. Accuracy includes locating all features correctly. Conventions include appropriate detailed title, accurate key, north arrow.

questions.text: Use the Figure 15 table and graph in Resource L (page 11 of the resource booklet) to describe, in detail, ONE temporal pattern shown.
questions.expectedAnswer: Describes temporal pattern of urban area or population growth in Singapore, e.g.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Describes the temporal pattern of urban area OR population of Singapore. Merit: Describes in detail the temporal pattern of urban area AND population, with specific data and evidence.

questions.text: Give reasons for the pattern described above and shown on the Figure 15 graph in Resource L (page 11 of the resource booklet).
questions.expectedAnswer: As population increases by 5.6 million, more urban land is needed.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explains the reasons for the pattern. Merit: Explains in detail the reasons, e.g. as population increases more land needed, shows positive relationship between population growth and urban area increase. Excellence: Shows thorough understanding with insight, explaining the positive relationship with specific data.

questions.text:
Use Resource H (page 9 of the resource booklet) and any other resources to accurately place these five events on the timeline outline below. Write the number of the event (1-5) on the timeline and give your timeline an accurate title.

1. A new port opens
2. East India Company buys the island
3. Singapore tourism board established
4. First container terminal at Tanjong Pagar opens
5. Changi Airport opens
questions.expectedAnswer: Events placed accurately on timeline: East India Company buys island (earliest), new port opens,...
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Places events with some level of accuracy, events labelled on timeline using numbers or text. Merit: Places events with a high level of accuracy, accurately locates and labels events using the text or numbers.

questions.text:
Location, accessibility, and change in Singapore

How has the location and accessibility of Singapore contributed to the development/change of its natural and cultural environment over time?

Refer to a range of resources from the resource booklet in your answer.
questions.expectedAnswer: Discusses how Singapore's strategic location as a trading hub and its accessibility via port and...
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Shows understanding of ONE of location, accessibility, change, or environment with general references. Merit: Shows detailed understanding of TWO concepts with specific references and explicit explanation. Excellence: Shows comprehensive understanding of all concepts — location, accessibility, and change in both natural and cultural environments. Explicitly explains aspects and their interrelationship.
